items.source: Enable cache locking to synchronize cache access across multiple cache instances.
items.translation: 启用缓存锁定以在多个缓存实例之间同步缓存访问。

items.source: Several Cache operations can be performed asynchronously or deferred and this is the default behavior for RedisCacheWriter. Enable immediate writes in case a particular cache requires stronger consistency (i.e. Cache writes must be visible immediately).
items.translation: 可以异步或延迟执行多种 Cache 操作，这也是 RedisCacheWriter 的默认行为。如果某个缓存需要更强的数据一致性（即缓存写入必须立即可见），请启用立即写入功能。

items.source: When using a reactive Redis driver, immediate writes lead to blocking.
items.translation: 使用响应式 Redis 驱动时，立即写入会导致阻塞。

items.source: Use immediate writes (i.e. write operations such as RedisCacheWriter.put(String, byte[], byte[], Duration) or RedisCacheWriter.clear(String, byte[])) shall apply immediately.
items.translation: 使用即时写入（即写操作，例如RedisCacheWriter.put(String, byte[], byte[], Duration)或RedisCacheWriter.clear(String, byte[])）必须立即生效。

items.source: Configure whether to use immediate writes (i.e. write operations such as RedisCacheWriter.put(String, byte[], byte[], Duration) or RedisCacheWriter.clear(String, byte[])) shall apply immediately.
items.translation: 配置是否使用即时写入（即写入操作，如RedisCacheWriter.put(String, byte[], byte[], Duration)或RedisCacheWriter.clear(String, byte[])）是否立即生效。

items.source: Configure the BatchStrategy when clearing the cache (i.e. bulk removal of cache keys).
items.translation: 在清除缓存（即批量删除缓存键）时，配置BatchStrategy。

items.source: Configure the CacheStatisticsCollector to use.
items.translation: 配置要使用的CacheStatisticsCollector。

items.source: Configure the CacheStatisticsCollector to use. This is useful for plugging in and/or customizing statistics collection.
items.translation: 配置要使用的CacheStatisticsCollector。这有助于插入和/或自定义统计信息的收集。

items.source: Configure cache locking to synchronize cache access across multiple cache instances.
items.translation: 配置缓存锁定以在多个缓存实例之间同步缓存访问。

items.source: If no batch strategy is specified, the RedisCacheWriter uses BatchStrategies.keys();
items.translation: 如果未指定批处理策略，RedisCacheWriter 将使用BatchStrategies.keys()；

items.source: If no statistics collector is specified, no statistics will be recorded. Statistics collection can be reconfigured on the built RedisCacheWriter by invoking RedisCacheWriter#withStatisticsCollector(CacheStatisticsCollector).
items.translation: 如果未指定统计收集器，则不会记录任何统计数据。可以通过调用 RedisCacheWriter#withStatisticsCollector(CacheStatisticsCollector) 在内置的 RedisCacheWriter 上重新配置统计收集功能。

items.source: Interface that allows for configuring a RedisCacheWriter.
items.translation: 允许配置RedisCacheWriter的接口。

items.source: configurerConsumer - a configuration function that configures RedisCacheWriter.CacheLockingConfiguration.
items.translation: `configurerConsumer` - 一个配置函数，用于配置RedisCacheWriter.CacheLockingConfiguration。

items.source: configurerConsumer - a configuration function that configures RedisCacheWriter.CacheLockingConfigurer.
items.translation: `configurerConsumer` - 一个配置函数，用于配置RedisCacheWriter.CacheLockingConfigurer。

items.source: enableImmediateWrites - whether write operations must be visible immediately.
items.translation: enableImmediateWrites - 写操作是否必须立即可见。
